name: Kit Builder
notes: v1.1.0 — new: Send to Force (EXPORT page, off by default) pushes the MPC .xpm export over SSH to an Akai Force running MockbaMod — bespoke, opt-in, see README for the one-time key setup. Fix: MPC .xpm exports played silent on any sampler that honors SliceEnd (including the Force above) — every pad's SliceEnd was hardcoded to 0; the exporter now reads each sample's real WAV frame count. Existing exports need re-exporting to pick up the fix. See CHANGELOG.md for details.
